name: print-social-lets-get-warm-fireplace-posts-with-repeated-offer-text
title: 'Let's Get Warm' fireplace pack with repeated 'Special Offer' lines and slate-blush blocks
whatItIs: Nine square posts pairing slate blue and blush blocks with fireside photos, a lead post with 'Let's Get Warm' in serif and italic and 'SPECIAL OFFER' repeated four times, 'Winter is coming' banners, a dog by the fire and circular discount badges.
whatItMeans: Cosy and seasonal; the repeated offer line adds rhythm and urgency to a calm palette.
techniques: Repeat a phrase in a stacked list for rhythm.
Split squares into colour blocks and photo halves.
Add a thin border inset to frame each post.

vocabulary.definition: Repeating a word or phrase for emphasis.
A thin frame drawn inside the edge.
